digest.component_or_area: plan-review overlay T13 and LLM-based criteria framework
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on prohibitions (new forbids); operator-approved widening requires it to also trigger on additive obligations (new contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, cross-site synchronization requirements)

P1 assessment measured a proposed content-triggered surface-parity criterion against 40 recent CLI-surface-changing commits and found 10% true-positive rate (write-parameter parity across library/CLI/MCP) and 70% false-positive rate (CLI-only changes with no MCP/NDJSON obligation); write-parity is now deterministically tested, making the LLM criterion redundant

P2 implementation widens T13's lexicon in the prompt and routing trigger, extends the deterministic pre-gate with an additive-obligation alternation branch (matching obligation vocabulary), and regenerates guide documentation; existing MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/UNCOVERED triage and fail-open rules remain unchanged

P0 deterministic import-walk (full importlib walk of rebar.* plus scripts/ leg) is approved as a replacement for the LLM import-integrity criterion; P3 obligation-parity overlay and ci-gate-compat criterion are rejected per operator ruling

Four commits in the measurement window (transition --reason, --force, close_class parity across MCP/CLI) represent a single escaped defect family now deterministically caught by the write-parity oracle; no historical sample subset would improve over the ~90%-none FP baseline of omitted-scope-site findings

Gerrit change 2035 (P2 implementation) required a second deterministic pre-gate branch to reach newly-widened additive-obligation phrasing ('callers must', 'must stay in step', 'new contract/invariant'); audit-verbatim enforcement remains unchanged and new unit coverage added
